text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation 
Festival. The Umamusume participate in a 
wide variety of competitions right in 
front of their fans.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno is also participating in one of 
the events, but...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes! This event is immensely popular with 
the fans because the competing Umamusume 
run dressed up in fancy outfits!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Especially that outfit of hers—it seems to 
really strike a chord with the children...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"It's my secret plan. —To win the hearts 
of children."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "CASE: Witness Interview"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
My, what an honor. Even if it is just for 
the Fan Thanks Festival, to have the 
chance to run with Fenomeno-san...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Verxina. She's from my generation, an 
Umamusume who set her sights on the Triple 
Tiara.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Likewise. So you're taking on the "Costume 
Change Race" as well, Verxina-san.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My little sister Vivlos begged me for 
it... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Well, this is an event where you "change" 
into a dress, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Win Variation-san. A hard-working horse 
girl from the generation above us, and a 
classmate of the famous Orfe-san.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I get how your little sister feels! She 
just wants to see her big sister looking 
beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you also in this event so someone 
will see you, Shion?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Ah—no, I'm...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...It's to push myself to the limit.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I wondered if being in a high-profile 
event and feeling that pressure might help 
me change too.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Oh, Shion-san...!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I have a similar reason, sir!! Let us 
both do our absolute best!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And now, we begin: the "2000m Costume 
Change Race"!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Racers, pick a prompt from the table, 
change into the designated costume, and 
run! Ready...—

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Start!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaahâ!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable! Fenomeno is the first to 
burst out! She grabs her prompt and heads 
into the changing box!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Next, the other Umamusume head into the 
changing room! Now, who will be the first 
to dash out—?!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Breaking away first are Verxina and Win 
Variation!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Waaah, so lovely!" "So fluffy~!" "Look, 
everyone looks so beautiful!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"While everyone else has dashed onto the 
track, Fenomeno, who dived in first, is 
still in the locker room!? Will she make 
it in time!?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Heh... There is no need to panic...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
This is... Operation "Heroes of Justice 
Always Arrive Late"!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(This is a proven trope passed down 
through renowned detective dramas! A 
dramatic turnaround born from confusion 
and bewilderment!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(On top of that, I'll show them through 
proper running! It's perfect! For I shall 
run with utmost dedication to make up for 
lost ground!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(While grabbing their attention, we can 
also show the children what it means to 
never give up! —There are zero flaws in 
this plan!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's a dead heat for the lead! Does 
Verxina have a slight edge!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Now! If we launch from here and break into 
the lead pack—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rip!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ah, aah...!? I have to change clothes 
again, sirrr!?

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The other Umamusume ride the momentum too! 
Now, which Umamusume will seize victory?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "W-Wait! Wait!! Pleeeease waaaaait!!"

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, that was so cool~! Verxina! And Win 
Variation too!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you're right~! Oh? It looks like the 
last Umamusume has finally crossed the 
finish line!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Mom, Mama!! Forget that, Verxina's 
interview has already started! Let's go 
watch up close!

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text:
Papaaa! Buy me Win Variation merch! Buy 
it, buy it, pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, despite a hard-fought effort, 
Fenomeno finished 6th. Unable to bring out 
her true potential, it ended up being an 
underwhelming result...
choice_data_list: Um, Fenomeno. What's this secret plan...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
choice_data_list: Change first, then let's talk in private

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I am terribly sorryyy!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I listen to Fenomeno recount the whole 
story from start to finish. In other 
words, she's...
choice_data_list:
Did you want to run in a way that would be 
a hit with the kids?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...I am deeply sorry!! It was extremely 
shallow thinking on my part!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Truly worthless... What a pathetic 
sight...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Boss?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I hesitated before speaking my next words.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...'Even without resorting to bizarre 
gimmicks, Fenomeno should be able to 
become someone's idol just by staying 
Fenomeno'... And yet."
choice_data_list: (What am I even supposed to say?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Because there was no guarantee of 
that, she rushed to take action."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Wouldn't telling them 'it'll be fine' in 
response just be running away into hollow 
comfort?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right now, rather than makeshift kindness, 
I need to act with what's truly best for 
her in mind—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What a pain in the aaaaass!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —!? Golshi-san!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, Meno! And you over there, 
Trainer, you listen too!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: This thing is, you seeâ

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: This is what it's all about!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... This is why people who can't even 
take things apart are so...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, come to the Satsuki Sho! Even if 
you can't swim, just come!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —I'll leave you in the dust.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: R A W F I S H ?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "W-Waaaait up!! Golshiiii-saaaan!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why Gold Ship left behind a tuna before 
taking off. Why she told me to come to the 
Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, her presence has always had the 
power to spur Fenomeno into motion, no 
matter the circumstances."
choice_data_list:
Ngh... What's the date of the Satsuki 
Sho—?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —This month.
